transliteration: Baro durgapahara baro duritahara baro sanmarga dari toruva guru ||a.pa||
Bala prahladanagi koola kashyapuvige lola sri narahari kala rupava toridi||
Vyasa nirmitakrantha madhva krita bhashyava besarisade poreva vyasa muniye ||
Mantra gruhadalli ninta yativaryara anta tiliyado ni antaradolu||
Bhuta pretagalanu bhitisi biduvanta khyatiyuta mati nathanr stutisuve
Kusta rogadigalanista maduvanta ashta mahimeyuta shreshta muniye|
Karedare baruvarembo kirti keli na karedeno karunadi kara pidiyo||
Bhaktavatsanembo birudu nindadare bhaktanna morekeli madhvesha vithaladasa ||
